dse_runs.notes: DDS spec: needs >=400 MSPS single-lane, max_abs_err <= 2^-12, minimise LUTs. Watch feasibility: pipelined families may be needed for throughput; check accuracy_bits >= 12.

final_text: Campaign complete. The single spec **infeasible_dds_400msps** (wideband DDS, ≥400 MSPS single-lane, max error ≤ 2⁻¹², minimise LUTs) was finalized as **infeasible** with no design selected. The full 400-evaluation L1 budget was spent: the structured DSE graph (100 evals) had its inner architect declare the spec infeasible, and I confirmed this by exhaustively probing the remaining families — pipelined (100), pipelined_m (100), and unrolled_k (100) — each yielding 0 feasible designs. No configuration in the explored design space (data_width 8–28, n_iter 4–30, guards, k/m 2–8) simultaneously met the 400 MSPS throughput and 2⁻¹² accuracy constraints, so L2 system simulation and L3–L5 verification were not applicable.
